name: Zapier
tagline: Connect your AI to 9,000+ apps via the hosted Zapier MCP server
description: Zapier MCP is a hosted server that connects your AI to 9,000+ apps, including Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Notion, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Send messages, pull data, trigger workflows — all in plain English. Zapier holds your app credentials, so Cline never handles a third-party API key.

install.notes: Authenticates with OAuth: sign in with your Zapier account when asked. Zapier connects Cline to your default MCP server, creating one if you don't have one yet. Then ask Cline to find and enable the actions you need, or manage them at https://mcp.zapier.com.
